annotations.text: Desktop-first flow: app opens on Browse. QR panel hands capture to the phone (code is generated from the server's LAN URL). Scans-in-flight live in the sidebar so the desktop is also the mission control.

Review (Ben's cut-out idea): every part is auto-CROPPED into its own photo from the model's bounding boxes - zero image processing, the crop is pure CSS on the original. Unclear parts keep the amber dashed treatment. The full shot stays on the left: selecting a row spotlights where its crop sits (crops can be loose when boxes are - context matters). The part crop also becomes the part's default key image in browse.

Part detail is a MODAL (Ben's call): click any browse card and it pops over the dimmed results, so search context is never lost - Esc or X drops you right back. Catalog photo from the product page can become the key image; original captures always stay in the strip. 'Look up' web-searches the canonical name. Serial/notes editable inline.
Phone capture leans into camera-first: big shutter = another angle of the same bin, Done submits and resets for the next bin. Live scan count up top.
